page.overview:
Who is Avon Starros' uncles?

At least two male members of the Starros Clan were the uncles of the human girl Avon Starros. Starros was kidnapped by a local group on Hosnian Prime, but was eventually found by her uncles, who then killed those that had taken their niece. In 232 BBY, while on the Outer Rim moon Wevo, Starros told the Dalnan boy Honesty Weft about the time she had been captured, and of her uncles' actions in finding her and then killing her kidnappers.

Avon Starros' uncles were mentioned in the 2021 junior novel The High Republic: A Test of Courage, written by Justina Ireland and published as part of the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project's
